turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Please send your order number, the email address you used at checkout, and the full new delivery address so I can check whether it can be changed.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.
Order SC-3360 has already shipped, so I couldn’t change the delivery address. I’ve handed this over to a colleague who will take over and check what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer verified with nora.blake@example.com wants to prevent delivery to checkout address and redirect SC-3360 to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Policy check returned already_shipped; no change filed. Please review available options.
